events.label: Kick-off
events.purpose: Set access to pharmacy data and people
events.decision: Confirm that the team can access pharmacy staff and current point-of-sale data?
agenda: Present the Diagnostic objective and workstreams
Review the pharmacy process areas to be covered
Confirm access to pharmacy staff and point-of-sale data

events.label: Check-in: first requirements
events.decision: Is the detail in the interim requirements right for the remaining process areas?
agenda: Present interim business requirements for the first process areas
Discuss gaps between current practice and requirements
Confirm the level of detail for the remaining areas

events.label: Requirements sign-off
events.purpose: Sign off business requirements and gaps
events.decision: Go or no-go on starting vendor selection against the signed-off requirements?
agenda: Present business requirements and practice gaps for sign-off
Review the interim requirements for the first process areas
Decide go or no-go on starting vendor selection

events.label: Check-in: vendor shortlist
events.decision: Confirm the vendor shortlist as the set taken to the selection gate?
agenda: Present the vendor shortlist against signed-off requirements
Discuss open vendor questions before final scoring
Confirm the shortlist for the selection gate

events.label: Vendor selection
events.decision: Which vendor's point-of-sale system is taken forward into implementation?
agenda: Present vendor scoring against signed-off requirements
Review the business case and vendor comparison
Decide which vendor goes into implementation

events.label: Check-in: system setup
events.purpose: Review first two configured process areas
events.decision: Confirm the tested first two process areas as the base for readiness testing?
agenda: Present the configured and tested system for the first two process areas
Review test results and open issues
Confirm the base for readiness testing

events.label: Workshop 1: pilot readiness
events.decision: Go or no-go on taking the pilot pharmacy live with the configured system?
agenda: Present readiness results from configuration and data load rehearsal
Review the configured and tested system for the first two process areas
Decide whether the pilot pharmacy goes live

events.label: Check-in: pilot stability
events.purpose: Review pilot record before waves 1 and 2
events.decision: Go or no-go on starting rollout waves 1 and 2 from the pilot record?
agenda: Present the pilot pharmacy go-live and stability record
Discuss open issues to resolve before waves 1 and 2
Decide whether waves 1 and 2 start

events.label: Workshop 2: waves 3 and 4
events.purpose: Review waves 1 and 2 before final waves
events.decision: Go or no-go on starting rollout waves 3 and 4 for the remaining pharmacies?
agenda: Present the go-live and stability record for waves 1 and 2
Review the training materials used with pharmacy teams
Decide whether waves 3 and 4 start

events.label: Final readout
events.purpose: Approve the rollout and close the engagement
events.decision: Approve the system as running in all 40 pharmacies and close the engagement?
agenda: Present the rollout record with stability check for all 40 pharmacies
Review open items after the final waves
Decide on approval and closing the engagement
